mia-csm: FYI HelioCore's new CreatorHub team just rolled out. They reported a 2.8x traffic increase in 72h and are hitting latency-sensitive streaming summaries. Renewal in ~10 weeks. They asked for a quick capacity plan + an enablement for their infra.

leo-sales: Do we have concrete numbers? baseline vs peak qps, avg tokens, and percent long-contexts? Also who is their infra contact?

mia-csm: Paste from their support ticket: baseline 95 req/s, recent peak 270 req/s, avg ~1.2k tokens/req, p95 gen latency ~480ms, ~15% of calls > 6k tokens. Infra lead: @nora-helio. Finance note: theyre sensitive to unit cost and may consolidate if we can't hit perf + price.

anya-se: 270 req/s at 1.2k tokens is substantial. Recommend proposing a short Dedicated pilot: 2 small pods, autoscale to 3-4 during peak, plus prefix cache and session hints. That should hit <500ms p95 for most endpoints if model stays 13B.

tara-eng: Confirming model question: are they on redwood-13b-opt or testing larger variants? If they switch to 33B it changes the ask. Any signals?

mia-csm: They started on redwood-13b-opt; a few QA endpoints use a 33B test. Majority is 13B.

jon-sre: I can run a replay in staging. Need a sanitized sample (ndjson or csv) and their peak-hour window. Can provision an autoscale policy for the pilot once we sign off.

ingest-bot: ingest-bot: short-logs-upload (helio-1796123456) created by mia-csm at 1796124000

mia-csm: I'll ask Nora for a sanitized 24h sample and their spike window; she said she'll try to send it today. Tentative enablement: Tue 11am ET with Nora + their SRE.

leo-sales: For renewal: propose pilot with conversion incentive (10% credit on first month if they commit to 3-month reserved capacity within 45 days). I'll draft a short commercial note.

anya-se: I'll prepare two config briefs: "latency-first" (more pods, minimal batching) and "cost-first" (aggressive batching, cache). Also a checklist for quantization/regression tests.

jon-sre: Action items: (1) Mia get sanitized logs, (2) Jon run staging replay and post p50/p95/GPU util, (3) Anya + Tara prepare runbook + one-pager on session cache hints, (4) Leo draft commercial note for renewal.

mia-csm: Thanks—I'll update once logs arrive.
